note: A PosQ-style positional-bias slice for the ranker: ONE query whose relevant passage is placed at the START, MIDDLE and END of an otherwise identical long carrier page, over a small distractor set. The carrier texts are fixtures generated deterministically by scripts/wiki_posq_check.py from the passage/filler recorded here — no corpus page is used and the golden set is never touched. The check REPORTS the positional behaviour of the real ranker (scripts/wiki_search.py hybrid_rank, severance disabled for the fixture set); it never retunes the ranker — ranker changes are battery-gated and are not this slice's act.
pattern: PosQ / 'Lost in the Middle' positional-bias probing (Liu et al.; the RAG-Retrieval Myopic Trap study's position-sensitivity shape, MIT) — re-implemented in our own code, no code copied
relevant_passage: The quixotic lantern protocol describes how a keeper signals ships when the harbour light fails.

carrier.title: Carrier page
carrier.filler_sentence: The harbour office keeps ordinary records of tides, repairs, stores, weather and routine correspondence.

distractors.shape: An ordinary page of the same filler carrying one partial query term (protocol) once, so the ranked list is not carriers-only.

collapse_criteria.meaning: The slice FAILS (rank collapse) if the carrier at any position ranks below max_rank, is absent from the results, or scores below min_score_ratio x the best-position carrier score. Anything short of collapse — including a real positional score delta — is reported as measured behaviour, not hidden.

ranker: scripts/wiki_search.py hybrid_rank (hybrid-current), severance=False over the fixture set
